about.title: Upland Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Grief does not follow a schedule, but California's legal deadlines do. That tension is why so many Upland families reach out to us weeks or months after a loss, unsure whether they still have options. In most cases they do. A wrongful death claim in San Bernardino County is a civil action, entirely separate from any criminal proceeding, and it belongs first to the surviving spouse or domestic partner and children, then to certain dependents and heirs. Upland recorded 2 traffic deaths in 2025 alongside 430 injury collisions, many along SR-210, Euclid Avenue, Mountain Avenue and Foothill Boulevard. Fatal losses also come from other places: a workplace, a hospital, a store's wet floor, a defective product. Whatever the cause, the law allows recovery of funeral and burial expenses, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the harder-to-measure loss of love, companionship and guidance. LawProactive is not a law firm. We simply connect you, free of charge, with an independent attorney who handles wrongful death cases on contingency, so you can focus on your family.

items.question: My family member was killed in a crash on SR-210 near Upland. Does it matter if the driver was charged?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action and moves forward independently of any criminal case in San Bernardino County. Even if no charges are filed, or the criminal case ends without a conviction, your family may still pursue a civil claim. The standard of proof in civil court is also different and generally lower.

items.question: How long do we have to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: Generally, two years from the date of death. If a government entity may share responsibility, for example a city vehicle or a public road defect, a formal claim usually must be submitted much sooner, often within six months. Because of these differences, speaking with an attorney early is wise even if you are not ready to make decisions.
